notes.title: The Countdown Begins: The Last Golfer Launches May 28th, 2025
notes.content:
After over a decade in the making, [b]The Last Golfer[/b] officially launches on [b]May 28th, 2025![/b]

We’ve poured our hearts, souls, and more than a few mulligans into crafting a unique blend of sci-fi adventure, puzzle-solving, and high-stakes golf. It’s been a long journey and we couldn’t be more excited to finally share it with the world.

A massive thank you to everyone who has wishlisted the game and supported us over the years. Your patience and encouragement have meant everything as we worked to deliver the best possible experience. 

The course is nearly open, and it's unlike any golf you’ve ever played.

– Karthik and Andrew, Drivehead Games

notes.title: The Last Golfer - A new name, the same game you’re excited for!
notes.content:
We’ve got some exciting news to share - GOLFR is getting a new name! 
From now on, our game will be called, [b]The Last Golfer[/b].

[h3]Why the change? [/h3]
We feel that [b]The Last Golfer[/b] is a better fit for our game’s theme and will help reduce any confusion caused by the alternate spelling of the original title. We want our game to be as easy to find as possible!

[h3]What’s changing?[/h3] 
Just the name! Everything else remains exactly the same. If you’ve had the game on your wishlist (huge thanks for that!), you don’t need to do anything. You’ll still get all the updates and notifications as before.

We can’t wait to share more with you soon. Stay tuned, and as always, thanks for your support!

– Karthik and Andrew, Drivehead Games

notes.title: GOLFR Gameplay Trailer
notes.content:
Hello Golfers,

Here is our new gameplay trailer showcasing many of the advanced features in GOLFR. In addition to accessible golfing mechanics, players will face challenges, battle enemies and solve intriguing puzzles as they journey through the deadliest courses in the universe.

[previewyoutube=PiUnAu_SJX8;full][/previewyoutube]
GOLFR is coming out later this year. Add it to your wishlist today.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537630

[h3]Gameplay Features[/h3]
[b]Full Swing Control[/b]
Use the mouse or gamepad to simulate an actual golf swing. 

[b]Mulligan | Rewind Shots[/b]
Bad shots can be retaken to give a second chance to the player, however each rewind costs one blue Mulligan token. Diligent players will discover many ways to earn these uncommon helpers.

[b]Sim Shot System | Practice Shots[/b]
Introducing the perfect holographic practice ball! The Sim Shot System temporarily replaces the ball with a holographic one allowing golfers to quickly and easily practice and achieve the perfect swing for any situation.

[b]Flight[/b]
Take to the skies for a better view of the landscape or to get out of range of inferior ground-locked enemies.

[b]Data Streams[/b]
Information is power! Completing holes rewards the player with a stream of collectable data. Harvest the data cubes to improve the robot’s power level.

[b]Relic Tracking[/b]
Mysterious relics have been carefully hidden throughout the world. Once unlocked, the robot’s tracking system will allow adventurous golfers to discover their hiding spots. 

[b]Ranged Combat[/b]
The golf club makes a fine throwing weapon capable of damaging offensive targets. Perfect for airing out the frustration of scoring multiple bogeys!

[b]Relic Rooms[/b]
Discovering special relics allows access to secret locations. Escaping the room requires the robot to complete a puzzle.

[b]Day-Night Cycle[/b]
The courses are open all day and all night. There’s nothing quite like making an eagle at dawn or driving off into the sunset.

[b]Photo Mode[/b]
Make the memories permanent by using the fun and flexible photo mode, a must-have for capturing those magical moments!

[h3]About Us[/h3]
GOLFR has been made primarily by two people who genuinely love making games and we want to share our creation with you, true gamers! We are grateful to the talented people who lent their skills and support to the development.

We look forward to hearing and seeing what you can do with GOLFR!
Andrew Laing
Karthik Subramanyam

notes.title: GOLFR is coming soon!
notes.content:
After a decade of development, we are excited to announce our game! GOLFR is a single-player golf adventure set on a distant planet. There’s exploration, combat, challenges and of course, golf.

[h3]Wishlist Now Active[/h3]
If you're looking for an exciting new golfing experience, please add GOLFR to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2537630/GOLFR/

[h3]Core Gameplay Features[/h3]
GOLFR® is set in the future on a distant planet, but there’s more to it than just golf.
[list]
[*] Level up your Robot to become more powerful.
[*] Explore the world and find helpful items to assist your journey.
[*] Conquer the puzzle areas and fight the resident defenders of the land, armed only with your trusty club.
[*] Swing your club with our simplified golf mechanics that allows you to drive, chip, and putt on either gamepad or mouse/keyboard.
[*] Master shots with our holographic practice mode or rewind bad shots using our mulligan system.
[/list]
We are delighted to tell you that there are no in-game purchases or microtransactions in GOLFR.

[h3]About Us[/h3]
GOLFR has been made primarily by two people who genuinely love making games and we want to share our creation with you, true gamers! We are grateful to the talented people who lent their skills and support to the development.

We look forward to hearing and seeing what you can do with GOLFR!
Andrew Laing
Karthik Subramanyam
